title: Classic British Welsh Rarebit ('Posh Cheese on Toast')
originalTitle: Classic British Welsh Rarebit ('Posh Cheese on Toast')
ingredients: 1/3 cup (80ml) dark British ale, stout, or lager (or milk)
200g (2 cups) aged sharp Cheddar or Red Leicester cheese, coarsely grated
1 tsp English mustard powder or Dijon mustard
1 egg yolk (optional, gives a soufflé-like golden blister under the broiler)
2 thick slices sourdough or country bread, toasted
instructions: Melt butter in a small saucepan over medium heat, stir in the flour, and cook the roux for 2 minutes until sandy and bubbling.

Gradually whisk in the warm beer/ale until a thick, smooth paste forms, then remove from high heat and stir in the grated aged Cheddar, Worcestershire sauce, mustard, and black pepper until melted (stir in optional egg yolk).
Toast the thick sourdough slices on both sides and pile the thick, savory cheese rarebit mixture edge-to-edge on top.
Broil under high heat for 2–3 minutes until bubbling, blistered, and deep golden brown. Finish with an extra splash of Worcestershire sauce.
